title: Signer-Set Pricing of a Closing and Funding Redraw
content:
**Schedule note.** The signer-set price of a Closing and Funding redraw is set from the borrower count on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File: where more borrowers sign than the closing method seats in one session, the redraw package price is charged once for every session needed, the borrowers divided by the seats and rounded up; where two or more borrowers sign within one session, it is the redraw package price plus 10.00 for each borrower beyond the first; otherwise it is the redraw package price as it stands.

| Closing method | Seats in one session |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing | 6 |
| Larkspur Escrow Dry-Funding Closing | 6 |
| Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing | 4 |
| Larkspur Hybrid eClosing | 6 |
| Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing | 4 |
| Larkspur Power of Attorney Closing | 6 |
| Larkspur Mail-Away Closing | 6 |

## Signer-set price by borrower count (hypothetical package price 175.00)

| Borrowers on the file | 6-seat method | 4-seat method |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 175.00 | 175.00 |
| 2 | 185.00 | 185.00 |
| 4 | 205.00 | 205.00 |
| 5 | 215.00 | 2 sessions: 350.00 |
| 9 | 2 sessions: 350.00 | 3 sessions: 525.00 |

Amounts are in US dollars.
